tagline: STIHL and outdoor power equipment, Franklin's trusted workshop
heroSubheading: Everything you need for your Franklin property, properly serviced and backed by people who know the gear.
aboutHtml:
We're Steve and Marlene Wright, running STIHL SHOP Pukekohe since 2015. From our purpose-built showroom on Wrightson Way, we stock STIHL outdoor power equipment, home heating gear, and everything else you'll need—from safety kit to spare parts to genuine advice about what will work on your place.

Our workshop is the heart of what we do. Our technicians are trained to service STIHL and a huge range of other brands, so whether it's a mower, hedgetrimmer, chainsaw or anything else, we can get it sorted. We sharpen chains, blades, trimmers, secateurs and clippers too. Every piece of gear that leaves our showroom is tested and ready to work.

Come in and talk to us about what you need. We're here Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 3pm.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Every item tested before leaving the showroom
